name: qwen3.8-27b-q4kxl
title: Qwen3.8-27B UD-Q4_K_XL (unsloth): the default for a 24 GB GPU
measured: RTX 3090 capped at 260 W, 15-11-2026: 30.7 tok/s on one request, ~118 tok/s in all on batches of 8; a 666-line C file summarised in 47 s (25 of 25 functions, 22 accurate); the agent's who-calls-what exact in 2-4 turns; renamed a local in 120 lines of C right 6 of 6 times. 21 GB of the GPU with the desktop's. At 350 W, 23-11-2026: 31-40 tok/s on one request, 119 tok/s in all on a batch of 16; the rename's code right 40 of 40 times, the whole file 32 of 40 (the other 8 also renamed the variable in sample.c's header comment); 95 of 96 function lines exact with --number. Q5_K_M and Q6_K were measured against it on the same day and did no better: see their profiles.

name: qwen3.8-27b-q5km
title: Qwen3.8-27B UD-Q5_K_M (unsloth): one step up from the default on a 24 GB GPU, measured no better
measured: RTX 3090 at 350 W, 23-11-2026, against the default on the same day: 29-36 tok/s on one request (the default 31-40), 110 tok/s in all on a batch of 16 (119); the rename's code right 40 of 40 times, the whole file 34 of 40 (32 of 40), the same comment as the default's misses; map, agent and 94 of 96 function lines with --number as the default. 23.9 GB of the GPU with the desktop's at 64K and 8 slots, ~0.6 GB to spare: past that, Windows moves memory to system RAM and everything crawls. Nothing on bench/bench.py is better than the default's, and it is slower.

name: qwen3.8-27b-q6k
title: Qwen3.8-27B UD-Q6_K (unsloth): 6-bit on a 24 GB GPU with 48K of context, measured no better than the default
measured: RTX 3090 at 350 W, 23-11-2026, against the default on the same day: 27-29 tok/s on one request (the default 31-40), 74 tok/s in all on a batch of 16 with its 4 slots (119 with 8); the rename's code right 40 of 40 times, the whole file 34 of 40 (32 of 40), the same comment as the default's misses; map and agent as the default; 95 of 96 function lines with --number, but written "(125)" where "(line 125)" was asked. 23.9 GB of the GPU with the desktop's at 48K and 4 slots; 64K does not fit. Slower, a smaller context, fewer slots, and nothing on bench/bench.py better than the default's.

name: bonsai2-27b-q2_0
title: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B Q2_0 (PrismML): Qwen3.8-27B in ternary weights, for 12 GB and up, or for speed
status: measured on a 24 GB GPU only
measured: RTX 3090 capped at 260 W, 15-11-2026: 58.4 tok/s on one request (1.9x the Qwen above), about the same in batches; summaries, names and the agent as good as the Qwen above, but asked to rename a local in 120 lines of C it gave the code back unchanged 3 times of 6. 11.4 GB of the GPU with the desktop's, with 64K of context. Needs llama.cpp b11556 or newer (older builds load it and print garbage). PrismML's own fork runs a 5.9 GB PTQ1_0 pack at 81 tok/s on the same card: see the README.
use_for: reading in volume (summaries, names, logs, search); not exact code edits

name: qwen3.8-27b-iq3s
title: Qwen3.8-27B UD-IQ3_S (unsloth): for a 16 GB GPU
measured: Not measured. 12.0 GB of weights, so 32K of context and 4 slots should fit in 16 GB; a 3-bit quant loses more than the Q4_K_XL. Run bench/bench.py on it and send the numbers.

name: daisyrose-27b-q4km
title: DaisyRose-27B Q4_K_M (bartowski): RadixArk's fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B, to compare against the default on a 24 GB GPU
measured: Not measured. Qwen3.8-27B trained further by reinforcement learning on long agent tasks (RadixArk, 18-11-2026); its model card says it keeps the base's chat template, so the same settings as the default should fit, and the template patch is the first thing to check. RadixArk's own numbers, on its own harnesses, put it 2 to 4 points over Qwen3.8-27B on coding benchmarks and 12.0 against 5.6 on Terminal Bench 4.1. To become the default it has to match it on bench/bench.py: the rename right 6 of 6 times, the map of sample.c, the agent's turns, the same tok/s, and no more thinking tokens on the same task. The quantizer differs from the default's (bartowski's Q4_K_M against unsloth's UD-Q4_K_XL), so a small difference either way may be the quant and not the model.
